layout.corpus.bin: <title>\n<body bytes>\x1E per document; the 0x1E is omitted with --separator none
layout.seps.bin: 48B header: b"XSEP", u32 version=1, u32 flags(bit0=0x1E emitted), u32 anchor_stride=64, u64 doc_count, u64 corpus_bytes, u64 anchor_count, u64 base; then doc_count*u32 LE deltas (d[0]=start[0]-base, d[i]=start[i]-start[i-1]); then anchor_count*u64 LE absolute start offsets of every 64th document. rank_1E(pos): document i with start[i] <= pos; with 0x1e framing the separator of doc i is at start[i+1]-1
layout.titles.bin: 20B header: b"XTIT", u32 version=1, u32 doc_count, u64 payload_bytes; then the concatenated titles; then doc_count*u32 LE offsets relative to payload start; then doc_count*u16 LE lengths

namespace_filter: none: every <page> is indexed regardless of namespace prefix
separator_count_meaning: number of 0x1E bytes in corpus.bin (emitted separators + any 0x1E inside content); rule 1 requires it to equal doc_count when --separator is 0x1e
xml_entities: not decoded: title and <text> bytes are copied verbatim from the XML
